game.name: battleroyale
game.description: Battle Royale: a free-for-all last-one-standing shooter, AI bots only. Every seat is its own team with its own color - there are no allies. N players (2-16) spawn on a large generated arena's evenly spaced ring; a deterministic seed-derived offset rotates seat ownership of the unchanged pads each episode. Players have 20 hit points and ONE life: there is no respawn, so a death is final and the episode ends when one player is left standing (or the clock expires, in which case the deepest survivor ranks first). A shrinking circular safe zone squeezes the board over 150 seconds down to a 3% floor of its area; standing outside it costs a hit point every 48 ticks, and stepping back inside drains that exposure rather than resetting it. The tight final floor herds late survivors into final engagements, while gradual outside damage limits ring-only executions. In the late game, when three or fewer players remain, baseline bots close on the nearest living enemy while still respecting ring safety and normal aim/fire gates. Arena-anchored deterministic loot bands keep low guns broad across the board, mid guns intermediate, and heavy guns in the center; the non-gun center cluster remains compact even at the 3% floor. Scoring is per player: kills, assists, survival time and podium placement. Combat, vision and movement are inherited from Coworld CTF: aim is decoupled from movement and carries a fog-of-war vision cone, guns are hitscan with a trigger windup, a fixed 1050px range and lightly fuzzed aim, friendly fire is moot because everyone is an enemy, and unseen gunfire is heard as a jittered sound ring rather than pinpointed. Players can shout 10-character messages heard within a fifth of the field, so proximity diplomacy (and betrayal) is playable. Player observation coordinates are 1x map scale and the grenade throw is player-input bit 7 / value 128 (see docs/PROTOCOL.md).

mode.description: Match rules: ctf (classic team game) or ffa (battle royale).

lives.description: Lives per player. Out of lives = out for the round.

perks.description: Per-team perk buffs, keyed by team name. Vocabulary: armor (+1 max hp), scope (50% tighter gun aim), grenade (+25% throw range), thruster (+10% max speed), luck (10% of landed gun shots deal 2 damage) — magnitudes tunable via perkMods. A team's value is a flat array of perk names (the whole team shares them), an array of such arrays (per-policy groups for 2v2 seats, dealt to the team's distinct policies in join order), or an object keyed by policy name pinning each group to exactly that policy (unmatched policies get nothing). Omitted teams have no perks.

perkVocabulary.effect: 10% of landed gun shots deal 2 damage

skin.description: Cosmetic body-art skin for this slot's player. Rendering only: no gameplay effect and no observation-label change.

team.description: Fixed team for this seat. Green and yellow are only valid when teams is 4; with no team the seat is dealt slot mod teams.

slots.description: Optional fixed player slot team, color, skin, and token settings.

teams.description: Active team count: 2 (classic sides) or 4 (corner/plus free-for-all).

tokens.description: One connection token per player slot, indexed by slot.

mapPits.description: Generated-map trench count; 0 draws from the seed.

mapSeed.description: Terrain seed for mapPath gen/pool; -1 derives from the per-episode game seed.

mapSize.description: Generated-map size-class lock: small, standard, large, huge, or giant. Empty draws the size from the map seed.

mapSpec.description: Full expanded map geometry (obstacles, trenches, endzones) as a JSON object. Pins an exact authored map — e.g. a campaign cell's custom organic terrain — overriding mapPath/mapSeed/mapSize. Same format the replay config carries.

players.description: One player display-name object per player slot, indexed by slot.

scoring.description: End-of-game reward rule. "classic": the winning team scores +1 per losing team and each loser -1. "pot": every team antes one point and the winning team takes the whole pot, the losing teams splitting the forfeit evenly - 2 teams pay +2/-2, 4 teams pay +4/-1/-1/-1.

fastMode.description: Advance frames early when all players report ready.

gunRange.description: Maximum hitscan gun range in pixels.

maxTicks.description: Maximum game ticks before tiebreak, where 0 means no limit.

perkMods.description: Perk magnitude overrides. Fractions are 0..1: scopeAim = fraction of aim deviation removed, grenadeRange/thrusterSpeed = extra range/speed, luckChance = chance a landed shot is lucky; armorHp/luckDamage are hit-point counts (0..100).

handicaps.description: Per-team handicap that weakens a team, keyed by team name. Each value is 0..1: 0 = normal, 1 = 50% of shots miss, 1 life, 1 hit point, half max speed; values in between interpolate linearly. Omitted teams are unhandicapped. Intended for a league (e.g. Campaign) to level a dominating team.

hitPoints.description: Hit points per life. Each shot removes one; at zero you die.

mapLayout.description: Generated-map layout lock: sides, corners, or plus. Empty draws corners/plus from the map seed for 4-team games.

killPoints.description: FFA only: scoreboard and training-signal reward for the last damager of a kill; this shapes the signal only, never placement or Elo.

mapColumns.description: Generated-map obstacle-column count; 0 draws from the seed.

mapEndzone.description: Generated-map home-region shape (FFA draws no capture geometry, but the shape still sets the board's corners).

mapWindows.description: Generated-map glass-window count; 0 draws from the seed.

minPlayers.description: Players needed before the game countdown starts; omitted FFA configs derive it from numPlayers.

numPlayers.description: FFA seat count N; explicit values win, otherwise FFA derives it from players length or tokens length. Every ffa derivation (fixed spawn ring, seed-derived per-episode seat-to-pad rotation, lobby minPlayers, per-player containers) follows it. Must be 0 in ctf.

num_agents.description: Number of agent seats; must equal the player slot count. Used by the platform ladder service for block seating.

aimTurnRate.description: Aim rotation speed in brads (256ths of a turn) per tick while a rotate button is held. B rotates counter-clockwise, Select clockwise; movement never changes the aim.

mapSymmetry.description: Generated-map symmetry lock: mirror or rot180 (2-team shapes; empty draws from the map seed).

ringEnabled.description: FFA only: enable the shrinking circular safe zone.

assistPoints.description: FFA only: scoreboard and training-signal assist pot; this shapes the signal only, never placement or Elo.

closedRoster.description: Reject players outside the configured token/slot roster.

ffaGunDamage.description: FFA only: direct mid-tier gun damage per hit; low and heavy tiers use their named ladder constants.

ffaLootCount.description: FFA only: total items in the deterministic center loot cluster, weighted toward offense as it grows.

podiumPoints.description: FFA only: scoreboard and training-signal reward by final placement; this shapes the signal only, never placement or Elo.

respawnTicks.description: Ticks dead before respawning at home (~3s at 24 ticks/s).

visionBubble.description: Omnidirectional vision radius in pixels around each player, seen regardless of aim.

ffaLootRadius.description: FFA only: maximum center-cluster radius in map pixels.

gameOverTicks.description: Game over display duration in ticks.

ringDamageMax.description: FFA only: inert at the shipped one-point default; caps the integer damage charged by one ring hit when escalation is enabled.

ringShrinkSec.description: FFA only: seconds the safe zone takes to shrink from arena-covering to its floor radius.

visionConeDeg.description: Vision cone half-angle in degrees around the aim angle. Fog of war hides everything outside the cone, the vision bubble, and line of sight.

barrierPickups.description: Cardboard-barrier pickups per team, staged between base and center. A carried barrier places with the grenade button as a standing half-hex that blocks paint but not sight, takes 10 paintball hits, and is flattened by any cog that drives into it; carrying one excludes carrying a grenade. 0 disables the item (the default).

startWaitTicks.description: Lobby countdown ticks after enough players join.

barrageStartSec.description: Clock seconds remaining that latch the barrage on (30 = starts at 4:30 on a 5:00 clock).

carrierSpeedPct.description: Movement speed percentage while carrying the heart.

ffaLowGunSpawns.description: FFA only: low-tier gun pickup count; zero derives one per player and places them outside the center cluster.

ffaMidGunSpawns.description: FFA only: mid-tier gun pickup count; zero derives max(2, numPlayers div 4) and places them at mid radius.

fireWindupTicks.description: Ticks from trigger pull to the shot releasing (~0.2s at 24 ticks/s). Aim locks at the pull; a peeking target can duck back behind cover before the bullet leaves.

passivityRadius.description: FFA only: inert at the shipped zero default; when positive, players outside this distance from every other living player accrue isolation pressure.

ringDamageTicks.description: FFA only: ticks of outside-ring exposure per hit point lost.

barrageMaxPerSec.description: Grenade-barrage endgame: the launch rate the bombardment ramps up to, in grenades/second across the whole board. 0 disables the mode; requires maxTicks > 0 when set. With the barrage on, the time limit no longer ends the game — it plays past 0:00 under full bombardment until one team is wiped.

mapEndzoneRadius.description: Compact endzone radius; 0 draws from the seed.

ringFloorAreaPct.description: FFA only: safe-zone floor as a percent of arena area; the shipped default is a 3% final floor that herds late survivors while gradual outside damage limits ring-only executions.

assistWindowTicks.description: FFA only: scoreboard and training-signal assist window in ticks; this shapes the signal only, never placement or Elo.

dropWeaponOnDeath.description: FFA only: dormant by default. When enabled, a non-unarmed victim leaves a one-use weapon pickup at the death site; activation is a gameplay rule change requiring a future GameVersion bump.

ffaHeavyGunSpawns.description: FFA only: heavy-tier gun pickup count; zero derives max(1, numPlayers div 4) and places them in the center cluster.

fireCooldownTicks.description: Minimum ticks between shots (~0.5s at 24 ticks/s).

ringRecoveryTicks.description: FFA only: exposure ticks drained per tick spent inside the safe zone; 0 reproduces reset-on-entry.

barrageSaturateSec.description: Seconds from the latch until full saturation: whole board targeted at barrageMaxPerSec (30 = saturated exactly at 5:00 with the default start).

barrageStartPerSec.description: Grenade-barrage launch rate at the latch, along the map edges, grenades/second.

ffaLootRespawnTicks.description: FFA only: respawn cadence for offensive center-cluster pickups (sustain items keep the slower 30s cadence).

passivityGraceTicks.description: FFA only: inert while passivityRadius is zero; when enabled, isolated ticks before isolation pressure can damage.

ringDamageRampTicks.description: FFA only: inert at the shipped zero default; when enabled, accumulated outside-ring exposure adds integer damage steps to each ring hit.

passivityDamageTicks.description: FFA only: inert while passivityRadius is zero; when enabled, isolated ticks per point of isolation damage after grace.

survivalPointsPerSec.description: FFA only: scoreboard and training-signal reward per whole second alive; this shapes the signal only, never placement or Elo.

lobbyJoinTimeoutTicks.description: Finite matches only: abort the lobby when the roster is still short of minPlayers after this many lobby ticks (24 ticks = 1s), declaring the stuck seat via COGAME_PLAYER_FAILURE_URI so the platform charges the no-show to that policy. 0 = wait forever (default). The clock runs on lobby ticks, so board bake time never eats the budget.

passivityRecoveryTicks.description: FFA only: inert while passivityRadius is zero; when enabled, isolation exposure ticks drained per tick near another living player.

win.description: One win flag per player slot.

team.description: One team name (red or blue) per player slot.

kills.description: One kill count per player slot.

names.description: One player name or address per player slot.

damage.description: FFA only: damage dealt per player slot.

deaths.description: One death count per player slot.

scores.description: One scalar score per player slot.

captures.description: One heart-capture count per player slot.

winnerSlot.description: FFA only: the winning player slot, or -1 when nobody won.

survivalTicks.description: FFA only: ticks survived per player slot.

placementSlots.description: FFA only: player slots ordered by finishing place, winner first.

player.name: baseline
player.description: Minimal sprite-protocol baseline bot with an FFA doctrine: treat every visible actor as an opponent, contest the center loot, track and lead targets, and respect the ring. Image placeholder is replaced at deploy time.

variants.name: Battle Royale (12)
variants.description: Twelve-player free-for-all on random generated huge terrain: one life and 20 hit points each, arena-anchored low/mid/heavy loot bands, a compact center cluster, and a safe zone that shrinks to a 3% floor over 150 seconds. Players use an evenly spaced spawn ring whose fixed pad set is assigned to seats by a deterministic seed-derived rotation each episode. When three or fewer players remain, baseline bots close on the nearest living enemy while respecting ring safety and normal aim/fire gates. Every seat is its own team with its own color. Last player standing wins; scoring is per player (kills, assists, survival, podium).

Players use an evenly spaced spawn ring whose fixed pad set is assigned to seats by a deterministic seed-derived rotation each episode. When three or fewer players remain, baseline bots close on the nearest living enemy while respecting ring safety and normal aim/fire gates. Every seat is its own team with its own color; last player standing wins and scoring is per player.
